messages:
Ada: Follow-up from today's allocator sync. We need a minimal, safe rollout for soft leases + micro-compaction. I sketched a plan, pls poke holes.

Rohit: Two main risks: (1) compaction peak memory and (2) stale pointers during remap. Both need explicit contracts.

Lee: For stale pointers: allocator MUST not free old backing until runtime ACKs remap. Use versioned remap ids and an apply_ack RPC.

Ada: Agreed. For peak memory, proposal: micro-compaction only copies small batches (e.g., 4MB chunks) and publishes micro-remaps. This amortizes peak and keeps latency bounded.

Rohit: Micro-remaps need atomicity per-chunk. Runtime applies chunk-remap before allocator frees that chunk's old pages. If apply fails, allocator retries later; no frees.

Lee: Add admission control: allocator.explain_compact_cost(region) => {bytes_needed, peak_delta}. If peak_delta > node.headroom, allocator returns ETA or suggests batching across tenants.

Ada: Rollout plan: feature-flag behind node agent config. Phase1: compat mode (leases act as hard-pins). Phase2: enable soft leases + micro-compaction in dedicated pool. Phase3: 5% hosted canary. Auto-disable if live_frag_pct > 12% above baseline for 30m or compaction_peak_delta > 25% headroom.

Rohit: Telemetry to add: live_frag_pct, micro_compact_ops, micro_compact_fail_rate, remap_apply_latency, lease_revoke_rate. We'll use these in runbook alerts.

Lee: I'll implement the apply_ack handshake and compaction cost endpoints. Ada, can you add the rollout flags and run the 8h e2e harness?

tara-bot: Created issue https://git.company/infra/6012 for soft-lease+microcompact rollout.

Ada: Thanks — dropping PR links into the ticket when ready. Sync in arch sync next week. :ok_hand:
